MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: Part 2: Comfort with Video Display. Nine-item self-report Likert subscale (1=Strongly Disagree .. 7=Strongly Agree), administered pre-experiment. From the Duorhythm questionnaire.

item_01.Description: I am comfortable with viewing content on a video display for extended periods of time.

item_02.Description: I am able to focus on a video display without experiencing eye strain or discomfort.

item_03.Description: I am used to playing video games or performing tasks on a video display.

item_04.Description: I find it easy to read and interpret information on a video display.

item_05.Description: I am comfortable with using a video display in various lighting conditions.

item_06.Description: I am able to quickly adjust to changes in brightness or contrast on a video display.

item_07.Description: I am comfortable with viewing fast-moving content on a video display.

item_08.Description: I am able to follow moving objects on a video display without difficulty.

item_09.Description: I am comfortable with using a video display at different viewing distances.
